input.content: Inspect the shipped Paper Semantic Stage structure and chapter navigation.

ideal: The rendered Paper UI exposes one ordered five-chapter model through both desktop and mobile navigation, with one current-location announcement and focusable chapter destinations.
criteria: Pass only if the actual StageNavigation and PaperApp static render preserve the five exact chapters, accessible navigation labels, one live region, current-location state, and programmatically focusable destinations.
limitations: Target-browser responsive layout, keyboard operation, reduced-motion behavior, and visual review are unproven.

input.content: Activate the Method chapter from the keyboard.

ideal: Enter updates the controlled chapter and hash, prevents default navigation, scrolls the chapter into view, temporarily focuses its heading, and restores the heading outside the Tab order on blur; other keys are inert.
criteria: Pass only through the shipped StageNavigation keyboard and activation helpers; this deterministic source replay does not establish target-browser keyboard evidence.
limitations: Target-browser responsive layout, keyboard operation, reduced-motion behavior, and visual review are unproven.

input.content: Inspect source rules for small screens, touch targets, and reduced motion.

ideal: The shipped stylesheet contains the mobile rail breakpoint, hides the desktop rail at that breakpoint, preserves 44px navigation targets, and disables transitions and animations for reduced motion.
criteria: Pass only as deterministic stylesheet-source evidence; computed layout, device behavior, contrast, and visual quality still require target-browser review.
limitations: Target-browser responsive layout, keyboard operation, reduced-motion behavior, and visual review are unproven.
